changelog.zh:
Classpp-v0.1.8-alpha 围绕「教务数据导入」与「AI 能力」两条主线推进。新增「从教务网页识别」与「拾光教务导入」两条课表导入路径，补齐模型拉取、思考强度与推理等级配置，完善待办附件、日程提醒与桌面小组件；同时对周数弹窗、搜索框、空态、字体与浮层动效做了系统性视觉与交互打磨，并修复闪退、层级错位、抓取错误等多项问题。

## 新增
+ **新增**：从教务网页识别课表：新增底部只读网页地址栏（输入显示前往箭头、跳转后显示更多菜单，可切换手机 / 电脑 UA），确认后冻结网页快照缩小居中并接入识别光效，识别中可停止、失败回弹；课表页不再压缩到设备宽度，支持捏合缩放与拖动；地址栏上方接入模型与思考强度胶囊
+ **新增**：拾光教务导入：接入仓库索引、适配脚本与登录 WebView，首次自动拉取、之后手动更新；学校列表按首字母 A-Z 分组，选择学校浮层支持按名称 / id / 首字母过滤；抽出公共拾光搜索条 SheetSearchField，吸顶不销毁并跟随滚动在绘制阶段位移；导入浮层改为 LazyColumn 懒加载，索引进程内复用、打开前预热列表、行级跳过重组以消除卡顿；入口常显后补充「学校未适配」说明
+ **新增**：AI 模型与推理配置：支持从服务商拉取模型列表，适配 GLM、MiMo、Kimi、千问与百炼；新增「配置模型」浮层，可增删模型 ID 与推理等级；新增思考强度胶囊（关 / 开启 / 低 / 高 / 最高 / 极致，按服务商 2~5 级映射），拉取模型带回 DeepSeek effort 元数据与思考强度，服务商预设新增 AiThinkingControl 能力标记；推理等级在请求侧生效（OpenAI 兼容透传 reasoning_effort，Anthropic 命名预设映射 thinking 思考预算并钳位下限、丢 temperature），并提供常用等级快捷预设
+ **新增**：AI 对话与工具：新增「分享至 AI」功能；新增 get_current_time 工具；周课表查询覆盖全学期并支持课表概况；底部导航长按已选中的胶囊可呼出 AI 对话；一个配置方案支持多个模型名并在对话浮层切换；输入草稿改由仓库进程内持有，收起浮层重开仍在
+ **新增**：待办附件：详情浮层支持添加、打开与删除附件，按格式显示文档图标；同步附件元数据并按需下载打开，作业要求与附件名同步至备注；ZIP 备份包含待办附件
+ **新增**：首页小组件：新增 4×2「今日课程」小组件（Glance）
+ **新增**：个性化设置：新增日程分组，可设置其他日期显示逾期待办
+ **新增**：关于页：更新日志改用 Markdown 展示并独立于检查更新
+ **新增**：工程文档：新增技术栈文档

## 优化
+ **优化**：周数弹窗：按屏宽与可用高度自适应方格尺寸（384–450dp 铺满两侧 17dp 边距放大方格，超过 450dp 封顶 416dp 卡片，低于 400dp 由高度钳制、49dp 基准等比缩至 40dp 封底），阴影 evaluation 调至 52dp、投影加大至 56dp、底部投影留白 60dp，方格数字字号 23sp，点选延后到退场播完
+ **优化**：视觉与排版统一：空态组件图标统一 Primary 着色并统一到窗口正中，日程图片浮层接入空态；待办概览浮层去文案化（环心只留分数、周表纯图表、留意行换只读 SheetInfoCard）；统一圆角到 shapes 库，导航长按触感去重；浮层组间节奏统一 18dp；Markdown 渲染样式优化，标题字号上调（一级 20→23sp、二级 16→20sp），双模式、表格与引用配色；更新字体使用规范；WebView 页面排版统一，设置页顶栏 + 底部只读地址栏骨架，确认动作移至右上圆钮，错误提示统一 Toast
+ **优化**：Haze 磨砂与动效：AI 对话底部输入栏与胶囊玻璃同时采样消息内容与光球（CombinedBackdrop），底部改纯渐隐遮罩并略抬高；AI 识别导入浮层入口改为 CardSection；配置方案浮层接入共享 HazeRetreat 退让状态机；模型胶囊接入玻璃材质并改用机器人图标，思考强度胶囊改用大脑图标、间距 10dp，顶栏「对话」与「关闭」胶囊配色统一；全屏 WebView 页接入设置页同款进出场转场并补视差；课表跨周跳转改为旧周缩小淡出 + 目标周滑入，改用离场页图层捕获消除起手卡顿；系统栏让位全 app 统一稳定的 inset
+ **优化**：交互细节：搜索框点击热区扩到整条胶囊；周数胶囊箭头随弹窗开合旋转；待办分组页各分组独立排序，回收站 / 归档置灰排序块；自定义分组页新建待办默认归属该分组；时间方案调整每节课时间后下方逐节时间随即重算；逾期待办开关文案精简为「显示逾期待办」；日程页设置文案修改；切换课表导出当前课表改为保存 JSON 文件；AI 提示词待办行补时段 / 全天 / 地点、课程名独立注入为【课程标签】（快照 v2→v3→v4）
+ **优化**：文档规范：中文文案标点规范补充 SettingsCard 纯描述卡例外；更新安装器授权页与安装器一律跨任务拉起

## 修复
+ **修复**：release 启动闪退：保住 Room 数据库实现类构造器
+ **修复**： AI 配置 Anthropic 协议 404（模型名或服务地址不正确），修正「关」的执行语义（DeepSeek 思考默认开启，关档位显式发送 thinking.disabled）
+ **修复**： AI 工具流式空 name / id 覆盖真实工具名；修复 AI 对话浮层的管理对话浮层层级错位
+ **修复**： AI 配置方案另存时 API Key 与模型名迁移 / 置空、模型名为空未拦截提交、删除确认框层级不一致
+ **修复**： 网页课表合并公式少算一节、网页抓取取消被吞、教务表格抓取与同名课程冲突；修复教务网页识别页 WebView 闪烁与圆钮投影被内容盖住
+ **修复**： 日程提醒卡逾期待办过滤口径，查看日未逾期待办照常显示；修复日程时间轴竖排卡结束刻度与同刻对齐
+ **修复**： 周数弹窗窗口越界压掉一列方格、投影留白盖住胶囊后的死区
+ **修复**： 小部件只显示 2 条课程的问题；修复待办详情打开附件时浮层上下跳动
+ **修复**： 拾光垫片 alert 报错立即收口并保留脚本文案
changelog.en:
Classpp-v0.1.8-alpha advances along two main lines: academic-data import and AI capabilities. It adds two new timetable import paths — recognizing from the academic web page and importing from Shiguang Academic Affairs — completes model fetching, thinking-intensity, and reasoning-effort configuration, and improves todo attachments, day reminders, and the home-screen widget. It also delivers a systematic visual and interaction polish across the week-number sheet, search field, empty states, fonts, and overlay animations, and fixes a number of issues including crashes, layer misalignment, and scraping errors.

## New
+ **New**: Recognize timetable from the academic web page: adds a read-only address bar at the bottom (a go arrow while typing, a more menu after navigating, with mobile / desktop UA switching); after confirming, the page is frozen into a snapshot, scaled down and centered, and wired to the recognition light effect; recognition can be stopped mid-way and springs back on failure; the timetable page is no longer squeezed to device width and supports pinch-zoom and dragging; model and thinking-intensity capsules are docked above the address bar
+ **New**: Shiguang Academic Affairs import: integrates the repo index, adaptation scripts, and a login WebView, fetched automatically on first use and manually updatable afterwards; the school list is grouped A–Z by initial, and the school-picker sheet supports filtering by name / id / initial; a shared Shiguang search bar (SheetSearchField) stays mounted while stuck to the top and shifts during the draw phase as content scrolls; the import sheet now uses a lazy-loading LazyColumn, reuses the index in-process, prewarms the list before opening, and skips per-row recomposition to eliminate jank; after the entry became always visible, an "unadapted school" note was added
+ **New**: AI model and reasoning configuration: supports fetching model lists from providers, adapting to GLM, MiMo, Kimi, Qwen, and Bailian; adds a "Configure models" sheet for adding/removing model IDs and reasoning levels; adds a thinking-intensity capsule (Off / On / Low / High / Max / Ultra, mapped to each provider's 2~5 levels); fetched models carry DeepSeek effort metadata and thinking intensity, and provider presets gained an AiThinkingControl capability flag; reasoning levels take effect on the request side (OpenAI-compatible passes reasoning_effort through; Anthropic named presets map to the thinking budget with a floor clamp and drop temperature), plus quick presets for common levels
+ **New**: AI chat and tools: adds "Share to AI"; adds a get_current_time tool; weekly timetable queries cover the whole term and support a timetable overview; long-pressing the selected capsule in the bottom navigation brings up the AI chat; one profile can hold multiple model names, switchable in the chat sheet; input drafts are now held in-process by the repository and survive collapsing and reopening the sheet
+ **New**: Todo attachments: the detail sheet supports adding, opening, and deleting attachments with per-format document icons; attachment metadata is synced and downloaded on demand, and homework requirements and attachment names are synced into the note; ZIP backups include todo attachments
+ **New**: Home-screen widget: adds a 4×2 "Today's Classes" widget (Glance)
+ **New**: Personalization: adds a Day group, with an option to show overdue todos on other dates
+ **New**: About page: the changelog is now rendered as Markdown, independent of update checking
+ **New**: Project docs: adds a tech-stack document

## Improved
+ **Improved**: Week-number sheet: cell sizes adapt to screen width and available height (384–450dp fills both sides with 17dp margins to enlarge cells, above 450dp the card caps at 416dp, below 400dp height clamps with the 49dp baseline scaling down proportionally to a 40dp floor); shadow evaluation raised to 52dp, drop shadow enlarged to 56dp, bottom shadow padding 60dp; cell number font size 23sp; tap selection is deferred until the exit animation finishes
+ **Improved**: Unified visuals and typography: empty-state icons are uniformly tinted Primary and centered in the window, and the Day image sheet gains an empty state; the todo overview sheet is de-textified (the ring center keeps only the score, the week chart is a pure chart, and the attention row becomes a read-only SheetInfoCard); corner radii are unified to the shapes library, navigation long-press haptics de-duplicated; overlay group rhythm unified at 18dp; Markdown rendering styles refined with larger heading sizes (H1 20→23sp, H2 16→20sp) and dual-mode, table, and quote colors; font usage guidelines updated; WebView page typography unified with a Settings-style top bar + bottom read-only address bar skeleton, the confirm action moved to a round button at the top right, and error prompts unified to Toast
+ **Improved**: Haze blur and motion: the AI chat bottom input bar and capsule glass sample both message content and the light orb (CombinedBackdrop), with the bottom switched to a pure fade mask and raised slightly; the AI import sheet entry became a CardSection; the profile sheet adopts the shared HazeRetreat retreat state machine; the model capsule gets glass material and a robot icon, the thinking-intensity capsule a brain icon with 10dp spacing, and the top-bar "Chat" and "Close" capsules share one color scheme; the full-screen WebView page adopts the Settings-style enter/exit transition with parallax; cross-week timetable jumps now shrink-and-fade the old week while sliding in the target week, capturing the exiting page's layer to remove the initial jank; system bars give way to a unified, stable inset across the whole app
+ **Improved**: Interaction details: the search field's tap target extends to the whole capsule; the week capsule's arrow rotates with the sheet; todo group pages sort each group independently, with Recycle Bin / Archive sort blocks greyed out; new todos on a custom group page default to that group; after adjusting per-period times in a time scheme, the per-period times below recalculate immediately; the overdue toggle copy is simplified to 'Show overdue todos'; Day page settings copy updated; switching timetables now saves the current timetable as a JSON file; the AI prompt's todo rows gain time slot / all-day / location, with course names injected independently as [course tags] (prompt snapshot v2→v3→v4)
+ **Improved**: Documentation standards: the Chinese punctuation spec gains a SettingsCard pure-description-card exception; the update installer's authorization page and the installer are always launched cross-task

## Fixed
+ **Fixed**: release startup crash: kept the Room database implementation class constructor
+ **Fixed**: AI configuration Anthropic protocol 404 (wrong model name or service address), and corrected the execution semantics of "Off" (DeepSeek thinking is on by default; the Off level explicitly sends thinking.disabled)
+ **Fixed**: AI tool streaming with empty name / id overwriting real tool names; fixed the manage-conversations sheet layer misalignment inside the AI chat sheet
+ **Fixed**: AI profile save-as now migrates / clears the API Key and model names, blocks submission when the model name is empty, and aligns the delete-confirmation dialog layer
+ **Fixed**: the web timetable merge formula undercounting a period, web scraping cancellation being swallowed, academic table scraping and same-name course conflicts; fixed WebView flicker and the round button's shadow being covered by content on the academic recognition page
+ **Fixed**: the Day reminder card's overdue-todo filtering, so todos not overdue on the viewed date still show; fixed the Day timeline vertical cards' end tick and same-period alignment
+ **Fixed**: the week-number sheet exceeding window bounds and clipping a column of cells, and the dead zone where the shadow padding covered the capsule
+ **Fixed**: the widget showing only 2 classes; fixed the todo detail sheet jumping up and down when opening an attachment
+ **Fixed**: the Shiguang shim's alert error now closes immediately while keeping the script copy

changelog.zh:
自 v0.1.5-alpha 发布以来，Classpp 完成了一次覆盖全应用的大版本迭代：以全新的 AI 助手为核心，把课表与待办真正串联起来；补齐打卡、归档、概览、调课调休、日历/闹钟与教务导入；同时重构设置页与关于页，并专项优化启动、切页、通知和长对话性能。以下按新增、优化、修复三类整理。

### 新增
- 全新 AI 助手，日程页顶栏即可唤起；支持多轮对话、流式回复、Markdown 排版、思考过程展示、气泡文本选择与多会话管理。
- AI 对话支持拍照或从相册添加图片；选择课表截图即可识别课程信息，核对后一键导入。
- AI 工具调用，可查询日程、周课表、待办详情与空闲时段，也能新建、完成、归档待办和创建分组/标签；修改与删除先生成确认卡，完成、归档等操作支持撤销。
- AI 设置支持多家服务商预设、OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 两种接口格式，以及多套配置方案保存与切换；API Key 使用系统安全存储。
- 待办打卡模式与完成情况日历，可长期记录打卡进度，并补勾或取消历史日期。
- 待办归档与概览浮层（今日收工进度、本周完成、逾期提醒、最近完成）；课程中心同步的作业/测验会自动归入对应分组，重复待办支持合并显示与完成情况查看。
- 待办可一键或批量添加到系统日历，未设置日期时按截止日或当天生成；也可添加到系统闹钟，并支持选择日历账户。
- 调课与调休，可将单次课程调整到其他周/星期/节次，或将整天课程平移到另一周/星期（节次不变）。
- 教务导入与同步体系，支持厦大教务网页登录导入，账号与同步页新增学校选择、每日自动同步、登录状态自动续期与头像同步，并可选在远端待办消失时标记完成。
- 数据管理页，支持课表、待办、标签、日程背景与 AI 对话记录的全量备份导出/导入，并可查看存储空间用量。
- 关于页支持检查更新、应用内下载安装与多版本更新日志，并补充致谢、免责声明、开源协议与隐私政策。

### 优化
- AI 对话的上下文与请求效率，提示词按需注入、历史图片以占位符代替、流式增量合并刷新，长对话更省流量也更跟手。
- AI 对话界面与动效，包括回复卡片间距、光场进出场、空态与错误提示、输入栏、会话切换以及底部留白区手势。
- 启动、切页与通知性能，启动关键路径并行装载、设置页子页按需加载并提前预热、日程/设置页转场更顺滑，通知与后台任务不再拖慢启动。
- 弹层与菜单体验，统一进场节奏与锚点位置，完善安全区与无障碍处理，退场保持毛玻璃，浮层顶栏模糊可关闭。
- 主题与视觉细节，新增两款主题色并适配深色模式，卡片与日历配色跟随主题，同时翻新字号、应用图标、设置页头图与空态组件。
- 设置页、AI 设置页、账号与同步页、课表编辑页和关于页的界面结构与文案，补齐英文翻译，统一子页滑动效果。
- 待办与日程细节，包括列表与删除动画、时间轴重叠窄卡自适应、打卡卡片行数、DayCalendar 与待办收集箱间距；重复次数上限提升至 999 次。
- 同步体验，合并自动同步与自动续期入口，补充同步失败兜底与状态提示，减少重复登录与同步中断。
- 无障碍与稳定性，预挂载页面内容不再被读屏误读，WebView 安全销毁，磨砂与弹层层级统一，降低闪退与掉帧风险。
- 数据与隐私，AI 设置页说明数据发送范围，API Key 经系统安全存储且不随备份迁移，对话历史可一键清空。

### 修复
- 多处偶发闪退，包括 AI 服务商菜单与账号页顶栏模糊、退出登录、WebView 销毁以及两小节课程合并等场景。
- AI 对话气泡跳闪与抖动、弹窗锚点漂移、底部留白区上下滑动失效，以及切换对话时的闪退与错帧。
- AI 对话偶发误报网络错误、重复请求与停止生成不及时，以及清空历史时的保存异常。
- 重复待办完成后仍在日程时间轴显示，以及时间轴重叠窄卡显示异常。
- 打卡任务完成情况日历无法修改、补勾范围不正确。
- 修改重复规则时旧规则未清零，以及调课数据丢失与导入异常。
- 输入框被顶栏遮挡、滚轮收起键盘卡顿、返回键行为不一致、菜单键盘闪烁与空态避让。
- 设置卡菜单再次点击不收起、过滚动判定失效、待办详情步骤输入框弹起时浮层不后退。
- 账号密码错误被误判为登录页改版、教务导入链接异常、AI 识别浮层光球被顶栏裁切。
changelog.en:
Since the v0.1.5-alpha release, Classpp has completed a major iteration across the entire app: a brand-new AI assistant at its core that truly connects the timetable and todos; newly added check-ins, archiving, the overview sheet, rescheduling and day swaps, calendar/alarms, and academic affairs import; rebuilt Settings and About pages; and dedicated optimizations for startup, screen switching, notifications, and long-conversation performance. The list below is organized into New, Improved, and Fixed.

### New
- A brand-new AI assistant, reachable from the Day screen top bar; supports multi-turn chat, streaming replies, Markdown rendering, the thinking process, selectable bubble text, and multiple conversations.
- Chat with photos taken with the camera or picked from the gallery; select a timetable screenshot to recognize courses and import them after confirmation.
- AI tool calls can look up your day plan, weekly timetable, todo details, and free slots, and can create, complete, or archive todos and create groups/tags. Edits and deletions show a confirmation card first; completing and archiving can be undone.
- AI settings offer provider presets, OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic API formats, and multiple saved profiles you can switch between. API keys are stored in the system secure storage.
- Check-in mode for todos with a completion calendar, so you can track long-term progress and backfill or clear past dates.
- Todo archive and an overview sheet (today's completion, weekly progress, overdue reminders, recently completed). Homework and quizzes synced from the course center are grouped automatically, and repeating todos can be merged with a completion view.
- Add todos to the system calendar one by one or in bulk; if a todo has no date, it falls back to the due date or today. Todos can also be added to the system alarm, with calendar account selection.
- Class rescheduling and day swaps: move a single class to another week/day/period, or move a whole day's classes to another week/day with periods unchanged.
- Academic affairs import and sync: sign in to XMU's academic affairs site in-app to import your timetable. The account and sync page now offers school selection, daily auto-sync, automatic login renewal, and avatar sync, with an option to complete todos that disappear remotely.
- Data management page with full backup export/import for timetables, todos, tags, day backgrounds, and AI chat history, plus storage usage.
- The About page now supports update checks, in-app download and install, and multi-version release notes, along with acknowledgements, disclaimer, open-source licenses, and privacy policy.

### Improved
- AI chat context and request efficiency: prompts are injected on demand, past images use placeholders, and streaming updates are batched, making long conversations lighter and more responsive.
- AI chat UI and motion, including reply card spacing, aurora enter/exit animation, empty and error states, the input bar, conversation switching, and gestures in the bottom blank area.
- Startup, screen switching, and notification performance: the startup critical path loads in parallel, Settings subpages load on demand with prewarming, Day/Settings transitions are smoother, and notifications and background work no longer slow startup.
- Sheets and menus: consistent enter timing and anchor positions, better safe-area and accessibility handling, live blur during exit, and an option to disable overlay top-bar blur.
- Theme and visual details: two new accent colors with dark-mode support, cards and calendar colors follow the theme, plus refreshed type scale, app icon, Settings header art, and empty-state components.
- UI structure and copy across Settings, AI Settings, Account and Sync, timetable editing, and About, with completed English translations and consistent subpage transitions.
- Todo and Day details: list and deletion animations, overlapping narrow cards in the timeline, check-in card line counts, DayCalendar and todo inbox spacing; the repeat count limit is now 999.
- Sync experience: auto-sync and auto-renewal are combined, with better failure fallbacks and status messages, fewer repeated logins and sync interruptions.
- Accessibility and stability: preloaded page content is no longer misread by screen readers, WebViews are destroyed safely, blur and sheet layering are unified, and crash and frame-drop risks are reduced.
- Data and privacy: AI Settings explains what data is sent, API keys use system secure storage and are excluded from backups, and chat history can be cleared in one tap.

### Fixed
- Occasional crashes in several places, including the AI provider menu, Account page top-bar blur, sign-out, WebView destruction, and merging two class periods.
- AI chat bubbles flickering and shaking, sheet anchors drifting, vertical scrolling in the bottom blank area, and crashes or frame glitches when switching conversations.
- AI chat occasionally reporting false network errors, duplicate requests, slow stop-generation, and save errors when clearing history.
- Completed repeating todos still showing on the Day timeline, and overlapping narrow cards displaying incorrectly.
- The check-in completion calendar could not be edited and backfill dates were incorrect.
- Old repeat rules were not cleared when editing, and rescheduled classes could lose data or fail to import.
- Input fields covered by the top bar, wheel pickers lagging when dismissing the keyboard, inconsistent back-button behavior, menu keyboard flicker, and empty-state avoidance.
- Settings card menus not closing on a second tap, broken overscroll detection, and the todo detail sheet not moving back when the step input opens the keyboard.
- Wrong passwords being mistaken for a redesigned login page, broken academic affairs import links, and the AI import sheet's light orb being clipped by the top bar.
